I am now locating where the handler calls DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook during memo creation.

A comment in memo_service.go at line 603 appears relevant to the webhook dispatch logic.

Checking whether DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook is a defined function or merely a comment. Also examining the CreateMemo handler around line 157.

A leftover comment was found at line 603.

The handler in `memo_service.go` calls `s.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`, defined in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. That function invokes `s.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, which calls `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` to perform the HTTP delivery.

The delivery package is `internal/webhook`, where `PostAsync` enqueues requests and `Post` performs the actual HTTP delivery. The signing mechanism is HMAC-SHA256, following the Standard Webhooks specification with `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` headers.

The dispatcher is `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. The delivery package is `internal/webhook`, which implements HTTP directly with `net/http` instead of using a third-party library.
